visualReview.finding: The rounded shoulder coverage reads somewhat more complete, but the whole-form comparison remains well short of the owner target. The largest mismatch is the broad smooth egg-shaped breast, which lacks the reference’s dense layered mechanical construction and transitions. Next are the oversized, plain annular eye/empty face, and the light narrow leg members beneath a heavy torso. Gray Workbench rendering limits material judgment.

limits: Copied V30 body-screen strict edge-through-face kernel: evaluated world-space BVH candidates followed by strict triangle edge crossing through triangle interior; plane epsilon 1e-7 m, barycentric/edge margin 1e-6. Bounds used only to prune disjoint objects. Same-owner pairs are reported separately, not suppressed. Same discrete breast opening, guard and shove angles as V30 body-screen. Scope excludes cranial-region changed meshes; this is not a whole-model crossing count. Discrete poses only; no continuous motion, containment, coplanar/tangent contact, self-intersection, or physical-fit proof.
